note: SPEC §20.2 — what people type, mapped onto the open library's textbook names. The library calls the back squat 'Barbell Full Squat' and the barbell row 'Barbell Bent Over Row'; nobody searches for those. scripts/seed-exercises.ts folds these into each exercise's aliases alongside the shorthand core/exercises.ts derives automatically. Keys are the library's own ids, kept here rather than in code so a wrong mapping shows up in a diff.

missing.note: Movements the library has no entry for at all. Aliased onto the nearest real thing so a search still lands somewhere, and listed here so it is clear that is what happened. Worth hand-authoring later.
missing.face pull: no entry; aliased onto rear-delt rows and raises
missing.barbell hip thrust: only the barbell glute bridge exists, which is the same pattern off a lower bench
missing.bulgarian split squat: no rear-foot-elevated entry; aliased onto the single-leg split squat, which is the same movement without the bench
missing.rowing machine: no erg of any kind in the library; nothing close enough to alias onto
